_comment: Selecting a capability and being allowed to use it are different questions,
and the router asks the second one before it answers the first. A router
that only matched would let permission be enforced by whoever loads the
result — which means it is enforced by every caller, separately, forever.

rules.statement: A route may only name a capability the requesting actor is permitted to use.
rules.enforced_by: SCL/policy.py::may_use, called by SMS/router.py before a Route is returned
